reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding — the issue is a filter that is absent, not a dead function). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE; entry point is an end-user HTTP request — not a trusted internal source. Gate 3: src/app/dashboard/ is explicitly in scope. Code confirmed at L102-108: member.members queried by supabase_auth_user_id with no .is('deleted_at', null) predicate, so soft-deleted members pass the only profile gate and gain full dashboard access. An attacker can trigger this via the Discord OAuth login flow by navigating to /dashboard with an existing session cookie after account soft-deletion, causing unauthorized attendance recording and team data access.
